description: 经典蓝调 - 稳健清晰的通用商务排版，低装饰、层级明确，适合产品 / 科普 / 通用长文

styles.body: font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; color: #1f2329; line-height: 1.85; letter-spacing: 0.25px; padding: 14px 12px; background: #ffffff;
styles.h1: font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.38; margin: 34px 0 18px; padding-bottom: 10px; color: #102a43; font-weight: 800; border-bottom: 2px solid #1f6feb;
styles.h2: font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.45; margin: 32px 0 16px; color: #16324f; font-weight: 750; border-left: 4px solid #1f6feb; padding: 7px 0 7px 12px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #eef6ff 0%, #ffffff 78%);
styles.h3: font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; margin: 26px 0 12px; color: #1f4b7a; font-weight: 700; padding-bottom: 5px; border-bottom: 1px dashed #b8cce0;
styles.p: margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.85; color: #1f2329; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: margin: 22px 0; padding: 16px 18px; color: #1f4b7a; background: #eef6ff; border-left: 3px solid #1f6feb; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.8;
styles.code_inline: font-family: Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.92em; background: #f2f4f8; padding: 0.1em 0.34em; border-radius: 4px;
styles.code_block: margin: 1em 0; padding: 1em; background: #0b1f35; color: #eaf2ff; border-radius: 8px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.6;
styles.li_bullet: display: inline-block; min-width: 16px; margin-right: 9px; color: #1f6feb; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900;
styles.li_number: display: inline-block; min-width: 26px; height: 22px; line-height: 22px; margin-right: 10px; background: #1f6feb; color: #ffffff; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; border-radius: 3px; vertical-align: 1px;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin: 22px 0; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid #d0d7de; table-layout: fixed; word-break: break-word;
styles.th: border: 1px solid #d0d7de; padding: 9px 10px; background: #edf5fc; color: #16324f; text-align: left; font-weight: 700;
styles.td: border: 1px solid #d0d7de; padding: 9px 10px; text-align: left; vertical-align: top; color: #30363d; line-height: 1.6;
styles.caption: font-size: 12.5px; color: #7a7f87; text-align: center; margin-top: 9px; line-height: 1.6;
styles.section_divider: text-align: center; color: #8aa8c5; letter-spacing: 10px; font-size: 11px; margin: 36px 0; user-select: none;

highlights.hl_yellow: background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 58%, #fff1a8 58%); color: #102a43; padding: 0 3px; font-weight: 600;

list_style.label: 经典蓝色序号
list_style.num_container: display: inline-block; min-width: 26px; height: 22px; line-height: 22px; margin-right: 10px; background: #1f6feb; color: #ffffff; text-align: center; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; border-radius: 3px; vertical-align: 1px;
list_style.bullet_container: display: inline-block; min-width: 16px; margin-right: 9px; color: #1f6feb; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900;
